correctness.rationale: Conjugation by \(\sigma_x\otimes\sigma_x\) flips both Zeeman terms and preserves the XXZ interaction, giving \(H(B,b)\mapsto H(-B,-b)\). Qubit swap sends \(b\mapsto-b\) while preserving \(B\), and the two unitaries commute, so their product maps \(H(B,b)\) to \(H(-B,b)\). Functional calculus transfers this to the Gibbs state. Hilbert--Schmidt geometric discord is invariant under local unitaries and qubit swap exchanges which side is measured, yielding the two identities and all symmetric-function corollaries. The assigned numerical checker independently confirms the covariance to machine precision. No correctness defect is present.
